prose: Brandon Sterling joins InnerVerse to discuss how strategic trading reflects the process of alchemy, supported by Chance's analysis of Money Grows on the Tree of Knowledge by Tracy Twyman. We explore the mirror of modern markets and ancient temple rituals, how your time is being transmuted into someone else’s gold, and how to take your spiritual currency back and generate your own wealth.
From insider insights to market metaphysics, this is more than a money talk: it's a revelation of financial sorcery and a launch pad to monetary sovereignty.
